text: {"assertions":["A partial upload issue was discovered in storage/blob/uploader.rs where final parts of uploads would not be acknowledged.","The issue could be reproduced by uploading a 40 MB fixture over a throttled network connection.","The bug appeared only after the client had already performed a retry operation.","The root cause was an N+1 database query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The fix involved prefetching the relation with a single query and was submitted as PR #4039 on branch fix/partial-upload-1.","The fix prevented approximately 10 duplicate rows per day from being written to storage.","The uploader is implemented in Rust with module tests located in storage/blob/uploader.rs.","The work was completed on 2026-03-29."]}
